newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan makes private placement of 100 bln lire muni.
newsitem.headline: Milan makes private placement of 100 bln lire muni.

text.p: The city of Milan has decided to place its first 100 bln lire issue of 15-year municipal bonds (BOC) entirely with Italian private bank Banco Ambrosiano Veneto .
The city decided last week on a private placement for the bonds, issued at par with a coupon based on 12-month RIBOR with a spread of 11 basis points.
Mayor Marco Formentini told a news conference that Ambroveneto had offered the most advantageous terms after an unofficial tender involving 34 banks.
Proceeds from the issue will help pay for maintenance of council houses and the purchase of new buses.

The city, which in July got an S&P AA rating for its foreign currency debt, plans to issue a foreign currency denominated BOC for a value of 150 billion lire in early 1997 to help pay for projects such as renovating its famous La Scala opera house.
